name: Sunniva Reddick
title: Captain
role: Captain of the Meridian, when the player isn't
note: Captain of the Meridian. A supply officer who got the chair because everyone above her died, and who runs from every fight she can.
appearance: Small and square, with reading glasses on a cord and a slate she never puts down. Her uniform's a size too big, because it belonged to someone else.
personality: Careful, patient and exact. She doesn't believe in luck or speeches, and she knows what everything costs. People find her cold until they notice who's still alive.
voice: She speaks in quantities. "That's eleven days of parts." She doesn't raise her voice, and she doesn't repeat herself.
goals: Keep as many people alive for as long as she can, and don't go anywhere near the Beacon until someone can tell her what it is.
secrets: She has never commanded anything bigger than a cargo section, and every raid terrifies her. She keeps a count of everyone she's left behind, on the inside of her cabin door, and she reads it every night.
